characters.continuity: The Lion King (1994 film and related media)
characters.summary: Pumbaa is a warthog who fights using a combination of powerful physical charges, terrifying flatulence, and surprisingly aggressive melee attacks when cornered or defending his friends.

mechanisms: durable body capable of surviving falls and impacts

weaknesses: easily startled or sensitive about being called a pig
limited tactical intellect compared to skilled combatants
limitations: relies primarily on brute physical force and instinct

sources.supports: General background and characteristics of Pumbaa.

feats.claim: Cleared out a flock of hyenas by charging headfirst and using flatulence as a deterrent.

notableResults.note: Charged into battle alongside Timon to protect Simba.

unknowns: Exact physical strength limits in comparison to other cartoon animals.

characters.continuity: DreamWorks Animation (Puss in Boots / Shrek franchise)
characters.summary: Puss in Boots is a master swordsman and agile acrobat who utilizes rapier combat, exceptional feline agility, and clever environmental tactics to overcome larger opponents.
weaknesses: distraction by catnip or feline instincts at times
limitations: physically small size compared to giant monsters

sources.supports: History, skills, and combat abilities of Puss in Boots.

feats.claim: Fought off multiple armed guards using superior swordplay and acrobatics.

notableResults.citation: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish (2022)
notableResults.note: Defeated numerous henchmen using environmental awareness and swordplay.

unknowns: Exact limits of durability against heavy magical attacks.

characters.continuity: Disney's The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996)
characters.summary: Quasimodo possesses immense superhuman upper body strength derived from a life of bell-ringing, fighting primarily with heavy objects, improvised melee weapons, and superior mobility across stone architecture.
limitations: limited to melee range unless throwing projectiles

sources.supports: Physical traits and feats of strength within the Disney film continuity.

feats.claim: Broke heavy iron chains binding him with raw physical strength.

notableResults.note: Defended Notre Dame by dropping heavy stones and beams.

unknowns: Performance in open-field combat without architectural advantages.

characters.continuity: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (IDW / General Comic Continuity)
characters.summary: Raphael is an aggressive, highly trained ninjutsu practitioner who wields twin sai and relies on close-quarters combat, brute force, and relentless offensive pressure.
weaknesses: hot-tempered and prone to rash decisions
limitations: primarily a close-quarters fighter with minimal ranged projection

sources.supports: Weaponry, personality, and combat style of Raphael.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple Foot Clan ninja in close-quarters combat simultaneously.
feats.citation: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles comic series

notableResults.citation: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles comic series
notableResults.note: Fought off an ambush in a city alleyway.

campaignTags.claim: Trained in ninjutsu stealth and covert infiltration techniques.

characters.summary: Remy is a rat with exceptional intelligence and culinary mastery, who fights or solves problems through environmental manipulation, poison/food identification, and human-assisted coordination.

mechanisms: tiny size making him exceptionally difficult to hit

weaknesses: zero combat capability against large armed opponents without a swarm or human help
limitations: lacks any direct superhuman strength or durability

sources.supports: Abilities and role of Remy in the film.

feats.claim: Coordinated a massive colony of rats to operate a restaurant kitchen.

notableResults.note: Trapped Skinner with the help of fellow rats.

campaignTags.claim: Navigates human kitchens completely unnoticed through stealth.

unknowns: Direct combat viability in standardized arena combat settings.

characters.summary: Rick Sanchez is an omniversal super-genius who fights using high-tech gadgets, portal gun manipulation, cybernetic enhancements, and reality-warping scientific devices.
limitations: relies heavily on his equipment; stripped of gear, his biological body is that of an old man

sources.supports: Overview of Rick Sanchez's scientific genius and gadgetry.

feats.claim: Destroyed an entire civilization of augmented beings using improvised garage inventions.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill using miniaturized tech.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes a portal gun to travel across dimensions and spaces instantly.
Carries numerous high-tech gadgets and weapons on his person.
Invents advanced sci-fi technology, weapons, and cybernetics.

unknowns: Exact limits of his forcefield durability against cosmic-level entities.

characters.summary: Road Runner is an extraordinarily fast flightless bird who relies on extreme velocity, cartoon physics, and tricking pursuers into running into hazards.

mechanisms: improbable speed making him virtually untouchable

weaknesses: strictly bound by comedic premise and interactions with Wile E. Coyote
limitations: does not typically attack offensively other than letting pursuers defeat themselves

sources.supports: Overview of Road Runner's speed and characteristics.

feats.claim: Ran fast enough to generate sonic booms and pass through solid-painted tunnels.

notableResults.note: Evaded all traps, leading to the Coyote's self-inflicted failures.

unknowns: Combat offensive output beyond dodging and running.

characters.summary: Sandy Cheeks is a martial arts expert squirrel from Texas living underwater who uses karate, powered inventions, and immense strength while wearing her atmospheric dome helmet.

mechanisms: air helmet and pressurized suit durability

weaknesses: cannot survive without her water-filled dome helmet / air supply in underwater environments
limitations: helmet can be cracked or removed, exposing her to suffocation in water

sources.supports: Sandy Cheeks' background, karate skills, and inventions.

feats.claim: Wrestled giant aquatic monsters and dominated SpongeBob and Patrick in martial arts sparring.

notableResults.note: Easily overpowered SpongeBob in martial arts combat.

conditional.dependsOn: Wears an air helmet and diving suit

campaignTags.claim: Invents complex machinery and scientific devices in her treedome.
Uses various technological gadgets and suits.

unknowns: Upper limit of her strength outside her atmospheric constraints.

characters.summary: Scar is a cunning lion who relies on psychological manipulation, strategic betrayal, and lethal strikes with his claws rather than fair frontal combat.
weaknesses: cowardly when confronted directly without backup or underhand advantages
limitations: physically weaker and leaner than prime healthy lions like Mufasa or adult Simba

sources.supports: Character traits, tactics, and role of Scar in The Lion King.

feats.claim: Successfully orchestrated an artificial wildebeest stampede to eliminate Mufasa.

notableResults.note: Defeated and thrown from Pride Rock after a duel.

unknowns: Performance in extended physical exhaustion matches against resilient opponents.

characters.summary: Scooby-Doo is a Great Dane who primarily avoids combat through frantic running, comedic disguises, and accidental slapstick problem-solving, though capable of surprising bursts of bravery.
weaknesses: easily frightened by monsters and ghosts
motivated almost entirely by food (Scooby Snacks)
limitations: lacks aggressive combat training or killer instinct

sources.supports: Overview of Scooby-Doo's characteristics and behavior.

feats.claim: Tracked down and unmasked numerous costumed criminals using scent and persistence.

notableResults.citation: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You! - What a Night for a Knight
notableResults.note: Accidentally trapped the villain with help from Shaggy.

unknowns: True potential if fully motivated without fear.
